source: priora-end-state-demo.html (read-only). Geometry from buildSite(), ENV and frame(); values measured in Chromium at a 1920x1080 viewport.

coordinates.system: World = the demo isometric plane before the camera. Plan coordinates (x, y on the ground, z up, metres-ish) project as world = [(x - y) * cos30, (x + y) * 0.5 - z]. cos30 = 0.8660254.
coordinates.screen: Demo canvas px = world * s + [tx, ty] (see cameras). 1 screen px = 1/s world units.
coordinates.sw: The SVG uses --sw (1 screen px in world units) for every hairline, dash and label, as the demo does. Default 0.1664 = 1/6.01038 (overview). When a scene zooms, set --sw = 1 / scale-in-px-per-world-unit to keep hairlines and labels at the demo size, or leave it to let lines thicken with the zoom.

envelope.formula: superellipse on the ground: x = cx + a*sign(cos t)*|cos t|^(2/n), y = cy + b*sign(sin t)*|sin t|^(2/n), t = i/220*2pi

planGeometry.gateNote: The demo draws no gate. Site access reads from the road ends: main road y=40 runs east to x=112 past the loading area; west roads x=29 and x=32 run north to y=-2.

ground-crosses.note: Survey grid crosses on the ground plane inside 0.84 of the envelope (8 m grid, 1.4 m crosses).

roads.note: Four road edges: main road y=40 (x 28 to 112), service road y=44 (x 28 to 72), west roads x=29 (y -2 to 76) and x=32 (y -2 to 36).

loading-area.note: Paved loading apron (plan x 74 to 106, y 40 to 72), dashed boundary and four bay lines.

utilities.note: Utilities block (plan x 6 to 26, y 6 to 24, h 9) with louvres, roof plant and the stack (plan 20.5 to 23.5 x 8.5 to 11.5, z 9 to 21).

tanks.note: Two vertical tanks at plan (11, 31) and (20, 31), r 3.3, h 11 (tank farm T2 is the second).

pipe-bridge.note: Pipe bridge from utilities to the production hall (plan x 26 to 34 at y 15 and 16.6).

production-hall.note: Production Hall (plan x 34 to 74, y 8 to 36, h 12). Roof divided at x=47 and x=60 into roof zones 01, 02, 03.

roof-zone-01.note: Roof 01 (plan x 34 to 47). Relocation target of the change option "Move work outside affected zone" (Sprinkler Zone 1).

roof-zone-03.note: Roof 03 (plan x 60 to 74): the hero hot-work location, covered by Sprinkler Zone 3.

production-hall-2.note: Production Hall 2, the lower annex beside Roof 03 (plan x 74 to 94, y 8 to 30, h 9). Asset exposure in the deviation.

laboratory.note: Laboratory (plan x 6 to 26, y 38 to 58, h 11) with three fume stacks.

warehouse.note: Warehouse (plan x 34 to 70, y 46 to 72, h 10) with roof ribs and dock doors.

loading-area-containers.note: Two trailers at the warehouse dock doors, each a trailer box plus a cab box.

sprinkler-zone-3.note: Sprinkler Zone 3: roof of Production Hall roof 03 (plan x 60.6 to 73.4, y 8.6 to 35.4, z 12) plus the Production Hall 2 roof (plan x 74.6 to 93.4, y 8.6 to 29.4, z 9). 31 heads. Toggle class "off" on this group for the demo offline end state.

hotWorkNode.note: DEMO.hero.loc: Roof 03 centre, the hot-work node. Node glyph drawn at 1.5x in focus stages, 1.2x otherwise.

roof01Relocation.note: Change option 'Move work outside affected zone' moves the node here over 2600 ms (Roof 01, Sprinkler Zone 1).

sprinklerZone3Valve.note: Ripple origin: heads are ordered by plan distance from (74, 20); data-i is the ripple index (55 ms per step in the demo).

sprinklerZone3Label.note: Leader from the anchor to the offset point; name and status text start 4 px right of it. Status text: ACTIVE, OFFLINE or RESTORED.

heroExitPoint.note: Where the ray from the envelope centre through the hot-work node meets the envelope.

anchors.zoneLabelNote: Leader: vertical, from the anchor dot (r 1.6 px) by leaderPx screen px; text 10 px mono 500, letter-spacing .12em, ink-2 with a 3 px paper halo. The demo hides a label that would sit under a card or off the canvas.

label.note: Default placement on the front-left edge (index round(220*0.24)), 12 px outside the outer line. In focus stages the demo walks along the edge from the exit point and picks the first spot clear of every card; in the decision view it uses the shorter text.

envelope.drawOn: The demo draws the envelope with a dash-offset reveal over 2600 ms (easeInOut) starting 1000 ms after the site starts drawing; the fill fades in over 1600 ms.

sprinklerZone3.headIds: sz3-head-00 .. sz3-head-30 (data-i = ripple order from the valve)

states.active: Default. Faint zone fill, grey dashed outline (4 2.5 px), filled grey heads, label ACTIVE.
states.offline: Add class 'off' to #sprinkler-zone-3: fill clears, outline turns #34332f with 2 2 px dashes, heads hollow (paper fill, .9), a cross appears on each head (ripple 55 ms per data-i step, 450 ms fades), hatch fades in after 350 ms over 1100 ms. Label status text: OFFLINE.
states.restored: Remove 'off'. Label status text: RESTORED (change option 'Restore sprinkler protection').

sprinklerZone3.visibility: The demo hides the whole zone (opacity 0) until the hero stage ('sz-on'); the SVG shows it by default.

ambientSpots.note: Decorative pulses (ring r 5 px scaling .4 to 2.6 and fading over 1700 ms, plus a 1.8 px dot), every 380 ms in operating and 900 ms in portfolio, cycling through these 72 seeded spots in order. Never activity nodes.

activities.nodeLifecycle: Routine: spawn 'checking' (dashed ring spins) -> 'inside' after 1100 ms -> non-persistent ones retire (fade) after 7000 ms. Persistent ones stay for the final picture. Portfolio: spawn checking -> outcome after 800 ms; retained and transferred ones travel outside along their exit ray (1500 ms).

cameras._how: World to demo canvas px: screen = world * s + [tx, ty]; the canvas sits at page (0, 68), 1564x1012, left of the 356 px rail, under the 68 px header, at a 1920x1080 viewport. pageViewBox: use as the SVG viewBox on a full 1920x1080 frame to land every world point on the exact pixel it occupies in the demo screenshot. canvasViewBox: the same framing for a 1564x1012 box at page (0,68). centredViewBox: the same zoom (s) with the demo's target box centred in a 1920x1080 frame (the demo shifts it right or down to make room for its cards). targetBox: the world box computeView() fits into its free region. sw: set --sw on the site SVG to this so hairlines and labels stay at the demo's screen size.

overview.demoStep: Stages 'intro', 'operating' (A site already has insurance / Physical work changes the real risk) and 'portfolio' (The site keeps operating)

roof03CloseUp.demoStep: Stage 'hero': Hot work begins on Roof 03 (zoom cap 10)

somethingChanges.demoStep: Stage 'deviation': Something changes (zoom cap 9; the camera move runs 4200 ms, from 2000 ms into the stage)

decision.demoStep: Stage 'decision': The risk becomes a decision (whole envelope, node outside, framed left of the 600 px decision sheet; zoom cap 7.4)

transfer.demoStep: Stages 'transfer-packaging' / 'transfer-offers' / 'transfer-bound' (zoom cap 7; site pushed to the far left behind the packet and carriers)

outsideState._what: How the demo draws the 'outside envelope' state (stage 'deviation' onwards). Sequence: 150 ms sprinkler zone 3 offline (heads hollow in a ripple from the valve, 55 ms per head in data-i order, crosses appear, hatch fades in 350 ms later, outline turns dark and tighter-dashed, label switches ACTIVE to OFFLINE); 1300 ms the Automatic sprinkler protection check turns UNAVAILABLE and the hero node goes to 'checking' (spinning dashed ring r 9 px); 2000 ms heroExits: the node travels 3400 ms (easeInOutCubic) along the ray from the envelope centre through the node, on a slight arc (16 px peak), while the camera moves to the 'somethingChanges' framing over 4200 ms. The envelope membrane bulges with the node (Gaussian, sigma 26 px + 0.55 x bulge) until the node is 44 px past the edge, then pinches off: the bulge relaxes, a 6 px inward notch (sigma 16 px) and two short exit ticks stay at the exit point, and the dashed signal slice ring grows to r 28 px around the node. The node's state flips to 'outside' the instant it crosses the edge (crossV). An anchor ellipse (7x4 px, dashed) stays at the node's original roof position with a dashed signal tether to the node. The reticle (corner brackets, +/-22 px) sits on the node from the hero stage to the decision. All px sizes are screen px (constant under zoom).
outsideState.settleOffsetPx: clamp(34 + 6.2 * s, 58, 118) screen px beyond the edge, measured along the exit ray

sliceRing.style: circle, signal, 1 px, dashed 2.5 3 px, opacity .9

envelopeLabel.note: text-anchor middle, 10 px mono, letter-spacing .16em, ink-3

sliceRing.style: circle, signal, 1 px, dashed 2.5 3 px, opacity .9

envelopeLabel.note: text-anchor middle, 10 px mono, letter-spacing .16em, ink-3

deformation.usage: const r = heroDeviation(model.envelope.pointsWorld, model.envelope.normalsWorld, model.envelope.centreWorld, model.anchors.hotWorkNode.world, s, v, 1); r.outline -> envelope-outline d, r.outer -> envelope-outer d, r.P -> node position (world).

nodeGlyph.note: Activity node markup in screen px (the demo node group is translated to the node position and scaled by k: hero 1.5 in focus stages, 1.2 otherwise; other nodes 1). Symbols node-* in assets/site/glyphs.svg reproduce each state at 1:1.

parts.ring: circle r 6.6, ink stroke 1 px, stroke-opacity .42 (inside)
parts.checking: circle r 9, ink 1 px, dash 2.2 2.9, spins 2200 ms/turn; ring hidden
parts.outside: circle r 8.5 (1.7 px) + 4 ticks from 11.5 to 16 px (1.3 px), signal; dot becomes paper with a 1.3 px signal stroke; ring hidden
parts.changed: square 6.8 px (x -3.4) ink replaces the dot; ring stays
parts.retained: circle r 14 paper .94 fill, ink 1.1 px dash 1.4 2.4, diagonal hatch (ink .38, .8 px) inside r 13, paper disc r 5.4, dot on top
parts.transferred: capsule 40x20 rx 10 from x -12 (paper .92, ink 1.1 px) + inner capsule 34x14 rx 7 (.8 px) + clock at (15.5, 0) r 3.6 with hands; ring hidden
parts.pulse: spawn pulse: circle r 7 scaling to 3.4x and fading over 1500 ms
